questions.q: Who is known as the 'Father of Genetics'?
questions.explanation: Mendel worked on pea plants and discovered the laws of inheritance.

questions.q: What is the phenotypic ratio in the F₂ generation of a monohybrid cross?
questions.explanation: Tall : Dwarf = 3 : 1 in the F₂ generation.

questions.q: What is the F₂ phenotypic ratio of a dihybrid cross?
Which sex chromosomes does a human female have?
questions.explanation: Females have XX; males have XY.

questions.q: Who determines the sex of a child?
questions.explanation: All eggs carry X, but sperm carry X or Y, so the father's contribution decides.

questions.q: How many pairs of chromosomes are there in a human cell?
questions.explanation: Humans have 23 pairs: 22 autosome pairs and 1 pair of sex chromosomes.
